categories.main_business_segments: KYUNG NONG Corporation primarily operates in the manufacturing and sales of pesticides (crop protection products), fertilizers, and smart farming solutions. Subsidiaries engage in fertilizer production and sales, agricultural machinery and equipment sales, and retail. The company also has business activities in seeds, insects, and other agricultural materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced chemical synthesis and formulation technologies for pesticides including fungicides, insecticides, and herbicides. Fertilizer production involves customized compound fertilizers, controlled-release fertilizers, and organic fertilizers. Smart farming integrates ICT with agriculture for precision control and remote management of crop environments. The company operates modern production facilities with standardized processes and invests in R&D for eco-friendly and innovative agricultural chemicals.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include agricultural cooperatives, especially the National Agricultural Cooperative Federation (NongHyup), which accounts for over 45% of sales. The company serves farmers and agricultural businesses across South Korea, supplying crop protection products, fertilizers, and smart farming solutions. The fertilizer subsidiary also supplies regional cooperatives and retail distributors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in South Korea with manufacturing plants in Daegu and Ulsan, and multiple sales branches nationwide. While the main market is domestic, there is some export activity, particularly in fertilizers. The company is part of the Dong-O Group and maintains research collaborations with domestic universities and institutes.
categories.supply_chain_position: KYUNG NONG operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the agricultural supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and formulating crop protection chemicals and fertilizers, as well as distributing these products to cooperatives and farmers. It imports key raw materials and intermediates, relying on global suppliers for chemical inputs.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes R&D in developing environmentally friendly, low-toxicity pesticides and innovative fertilizers such as controlled-release and customized formulations. It is expanding its smart farming business by integrating ICT and precision agriculture technologies. Strategic priorities include product quality improvement, new product development, and expanding smart farm infrastructure including greenhouse construction.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of pesticides, fertilizers, seeds, and smart farming equipment. Sales channels include direct supply to agricultural cooperatives, wholesale and retail distributors, and some exports. The company also earns revenue from related services such as consulting and smart farm installation.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the pesticide market, KYUNG NONG competes with a few large domestic firms and multinational chemical companies operating in Korea, holding a significant market share in crop protection products. In fertilizers, its subsidiary Jovi holds about 8.4% market share in a competitive industry with approximately eight major players. The company positions itself as a leading integrated agricultural solutions provider with a strong domestic presence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of fiscal year 2023, consolidated sales were approximately 347.4 billion KRW, with operating profit of about 25.2 billion KRW, reflecting a slight decline compared to the previous year. The company has total assets around 448.6 billion KRW and equity of 268.5 billion KRW. Despite recent revenue decreases, the company maintains stable profitability and continues investing in R&D and smart farming expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: KYUNG NONG offers high-quality, safe, and environmentally friendly crop protection products and fertilizers tailored to local agricultural needs. Its integration of traditional agricultural chemicals with advanced smart farming technologies under the SIGNIT brand differentiates it as a comprehensive agricultural solutions provider. The company emphasizes customer satisfaction, product innovation, and sustainable agriculture to enhance farmer productivity and income.
